topic: Viewing and Editing Individual Student Details
summary: Details how to access and modify an individual student's comprehensive profile, including personal information, parent details, vehicle/transport assignment, hostel details, subject assignments, and document uploads. It also notes that default fields are configured in the entity setup.
steps: Locate the desired student in the list.
Click on the 'Action' button next to the student's name.
Select 'View' from the action options to open the student's detailed profile.
To update the student's profile picture, use the 'Update' option.
To edit details within any section (e.g., Personal Details, Parent Details), click the 'Edit' option specific to that section.
Make the necessary changes (e.g., update phone number).
Click 'Save' to apply and store the changes.
To assign transport to a student:
In the pop-up window, select the vehicle and route from the available options.
Enter the default amount for installments (e.g., April, May, June).
To upload or view student documents:
View existing documents (e.g., Aadhaar card, admit card, parent photographs).
Use the 'Upload again' option to replace an existing document or upload a new one.
business_rules: Default student fields (e.g., Gender) are configured in the entity setup, where their display names can be customized.
Transport assignment requires selecting a route and specifying installment amounts.
important_notes: The complete student display, encompassing fee and subject details, is part of the Student Information System (SIS).
Any detail can be edited by clicking 'Edit' in its respective section and then 'Save'.
